CRAN readiness — simulab 0.4.10

Source: CRAN_READINESS.md

Checked 2026-10-03 on R 4.5.2, aarch64-apple-darwin20, macOS Tahoe 26.3.1.

R CMD check

LC_ALL=C _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_=true _R_CHECK_CRAN_INCOMING_=true R CMD check --as-cran simulab_0.4.7.tar.gz, including the PDF reference manual, run with the output directory outside the repository:

0 errors, 0 warnings, 1 NOTE (New submission), on the final tarball below. The unable to verify current time NOTE seen on 2026-09-25 did not recur. Examples, tests, vignette re-build, PDF and HTML manual, and the incoming URL/DOI checks all pass.

Tests

  • With every suggested package installed: 1188 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skips, 0 warnings.
  • With tna, igraph, simstudy and survival made unavailable: 1089 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 19 skips; every Rd example and the vignette run.

The no-Suggests environment is reproduced by tracing loadNamespace() so that it raises packageNotFoundError for the hidden packages, before running devtools::test() and devtools::run_examples(run_donttest = TRUE):

trace(loadNamespace, tracer = quote(
  if (as.character(package) %in% c("tna", "igraph", "simstudy", "survival"))
    stop(errorCondition("hidden", class = "packageNotFoundError"))),
  print = FALSE, where = baseenv())

This pass found a real defect, which is now fixed: the seed-contract test errored without tna because simulate_group_tna() calls fit_tna().
